title: cdfplot
summary: Plot an empirical cumulative distribution function.
description: `cdfplot(x)` plots the empirical cumulative distribution function for a numeric vector. The empirical CDF at a value `t` is the fraction of non-NaN observations less than or equal to `t`.
notes: `h` is the line handle for the empirical CDF plot.
`stats` is a structure with `min`, `max`, `mean`, `median`, and sample `std` fields computed after omitting NaN values.
Use `ecdf` for numeric ECDF outputs, confidence bounds, frequency weights, survivor functions, and right-censored data.

examples.description: Plot an empirical CDF and read summary stats
